name: belgium-bookkeeping
description: Belgian bookkeeping for financial years running in 2026: who must keep books under the Code of Economic Law (WER / CDE art. III.82 to III.95), double-entry books for every company, the simplified three-journal method for sole traders, general partnerships and limited partnerships with turnover up to EUR 500,000 (EUR 620,000 for fuel retailers), the minimum chart of accounts (MAR / PCMN) in annex 1 to the Royal Decree of 21 October 2018, the 2019 valuation rules, the balance sheet and profit and loss schemes, the 2026 size criteria (micro, small, large), the 2026 NBB filing costs, retention periods and the links to corporate tax and VAT. Trigger on: Belgian bookkeeping, PCMN, MAR, minimumindeling, plan comptable minimum normalisé, boekhoudwet, single-entry books Belgium, jaarrekening, comptes annuels, chart of accounts Belgium. Out of scope: filing the accounts in depth (belgium-financial-statements), e-invoicing (belgium-einvoice), VAT returns (be-vat-return), corporate tax (be-corpora
